documentedAliases.text: In this invented picture record, eggs are seen on day 0, a tadpole on day 6, a froglet on day 60 and a tailless young frog on day 80. The observed interval from tadpole to froglet is 54 days; from froglet to tailless young frog it is 20 days. A young frog is not necessarily a reproducing adult. These are intervals between recorded sightings, not exact stage durations, because a change may have occurred between visits.
